messages.content:
You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. Person 2 says: "I'll pass you on my right." Which way do you move, left or right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Right
Because "my right" refers to Person 2's right side, which is your left, so you should move to your right to pass on your left while they pass on their right.
